summary.zh: 抗打断、更快且提升伤害的治疗之触，再加 20 级的大地母亲的恩赐。
summary.en: Pushback protection, a faster Healing Touch that also raises your damage, and Gift of the Earthmother at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，在 Beta 地下城中治疗

pros.zh: 自然集中让奥术与自然法术有 70% 几率不被伤害打断，这正是 20 级治疗真正丢施法的原因。
pros.en: Nature's Focus gives a 70% chance to avoid pushback on your Arcane and Nature casts, which is what a level-20 healer actually loses casts to.

pros.zh: 自然主义让治疗之触施法时间缩短 0.5 秒，并让你造成的所有伤害提高 5%，这套方案照样能刷任务。
pros.en: Naturalist cuts 0.5 seconds from Healing Touch and adds 5% to all the damage you deal, so the build still quests.

pros.zh: 大地母亲的恩赐让回春术与迅捷治愈的公共冷却缩短 0.5 秒，瞬发治疗的跟手程度明显提升。
pros.en: Gift of the Earthmother takes 0.5 seconds off the global cooldown of Rejuvenation and Swiftmend, which makes your instant heals noticeably more responsive.

pros.zh: 主要单刷？5 点起源加 1 点自然延伸、再加 5 点自然集中的分配杀得更快，代价是放弃大地母亲的恩赐。
pros.en: Mostly soloing? Five points in Genesis, one in Nature's Reach and five in Nature's Focus kills faster, at the cost of Gift of the Earthmother.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
